No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

On this walk you examine rock art without treating every image as securely datable.

The date, start time, pace and language are arranged to suit your group.

What it covers

  • Prehistory orientation at permitted zone
  • Accessible painted shelters
  • Rock surface and conservation observation
  • Chronology and interpretation discussion

How the time is spent

  1. Prehistory orientation at permitted zone 30 min

  2. Accessible painted shelters 45 min

  3. Rock surface and conservation observation 55 min

  4. Chronology and interpretation discussion 50 min

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Describe the accessible painted shelters at Bhimbetka within their prehistoric landscape.
  • Observe rock surfaces closely and recognise the conservation issues affecting the paintings.
  • Explain why not every rock art image can be securely dated, and how chronologies are argued.

You take away

An interpretation sheet with questions to ask on site and suggested reading.
